definitions.explanation: A student's official registration status at an educational institution. Includes their student ID number, enrollment dates, and academic standing.

examples.japanese: {学籍|がくせき}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me your student ID number.

examples.japanese: {休学中|きゅうがくちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{学籍|がくせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Even while on leave of absence, enrollment status remains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長期間|ちょうきかん}→長期間：25696_choukikan⟧{無届|むとどけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{欠席|けっせき}する→欠席する：22283_kessekisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{学籍|がくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you are absent for a long period without notification, you may lose your enrollment.

notes:
{学籍|がくせき} refers to a student's official registration status at a school or university. It encompasses the formal record of enrollment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学籍|がくせき}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: student ID number
- {学籍|がくせき}{簿|ぼ}: student register/enrollment roll
- {学籍|がくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose one's enrollment
- {学籍|がくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to have enrollment at (a school)

STATUS TYPES:
- ⟦{在籍|ざいせき}→在籍：21436_zaiseki⟧: currently enrolled
- ⟦{休学|きゅうがく}→休学：05140_kyuugaku⟧: leave of absence (enrollment is maintained)
- ⟦{退学|たいがく}→退学：03387_taigaku⟧: withdrawal/dropout (enrollment is lost)
- ⟦{除籍|じょせき}→除籍：24951_joseki⟧: removal from the register

USAGE:
For international students in Japan, maintaining {学籍|がくせき} is important because enrollment status is tied to student visa requirements. Long unauthorized absences can result in loss of {学籍|がくせき} and visa issues.
